item.title: Termzogs
item.description:
Termzogs is the second CLI game I’ve made. Yet again, it is based on a classic ZX81 game. This time inspired by the superb game Mazogs by Don Priestley.

For this game, I decided to give AI Vibe Coding a try. I was curious to find out two things. First, I wanted to see if it would make coding easier and faster (I was pretty sure it would manage that much). The second reason was to see if programming would still be enjoyable and rewarding, or if AI would take all the pleasure and satisfaction out of writing code.

item.title: CLI-Labyrinth
item.description:
One of the very first games I ever played on a home computer was a maze game called Labyrinth on the Sinclair ZX81. So when I wanted to learn Golang and delve a little deeper into terminal cli development, I decided to start with a simple maze game that could be run in a shell on the Linux command line.

As you can see from the screenshot, the graphics could, at best, be describes as very basic. But as a learning project, I’m quite pleased with the result.
